title: Keep the knowledge map's canvases pointer-events:none and let the container listen; never add wheel/touchmove listeners or pointer preventDefault
body: Rules that hold today in src/scripts/lab and src/styles/lab.css: 1) Both canvases are `pointer-events: none`; the CONTAINER `.lab__map` (tabindex=0) listens. That is what makes scroll capture impossible by construction. 2) Touch is arbitrated by the browser with `touch-action: pan-x pan-y` (lab.css:156): every one-finger swipe scrolls the page; rotation starts only with TWO pointers down; mouse drag rotates. 3) No `wheel` or `touchmove` listener anywhere in client code (asserted by `pnpm run test:bundle`). 4) No pointer preventDefault. Existing preventDefault calls are only: keyboard (interaction.ts:302 arrows on a focused map, boot.ts:138 Space on a list item) and `webglcontextlost` (field.ts:172, graph-3d.ts:644), which is required to allow context restore. 5) Hit testing is by projecting nodes to NDC, not THREE.Raycaster — the projection is computed anyway for labels. 6) The server-rendered SVG is never removed; the 3D layers on top and the SVG goes to opacity 0, so reverting (lost context, slow frames) is dropping a class. 7) Colors come from CSS tokens via getComputedStyle (no hex in JS) — a convention stated in comments, NOT checked by CI.
not_derivable: The rules are scattered across interaction.ts, graph-3d.ts, lab.css and a bundle test; the old summary in CLAUDE.md was stale (pan-y, keyboard-only preventDefault, hex 'CI-verified'), so code alone gives a fragmented picture.

evidence.summary: Header: canvas never receives pointer events; touch-action pan-x pan-y; rotation needs two pointers.
Header: both canvases pointer-events none; line 156 touch-action: pan-x pan-y.
Line ~231: test 'no client module listens for wheel or touchmove'.
Header: NDC hit test instead of Raycaster; line 77 colors from tokens; line 652 SVG never removed; line 644 contextlost preventDefault.
